item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins lawsuit requiring CFPB be fully funded
item.description:
Publication Date: September 28, 2026

Federal court rules Consumer Financial Protection Bureau must remain lawfully funded, resolving December 2025 AG Ellison and coalition of 22 AGs filed against former CFPB acting director’s attempt to defund it

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/09/28_CFPB.asp

item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins protections from Corteva to lower pesticide prices for farmers
item.description:
Publication Date: September 28, 2026

Settles 2022 bipartisan lawsuit that alleged Corteva implemented an anti-competitive post-patent loyalty program that paid distributors to block competitors from selling cheaper generic products to farmers, driving up farmers’ costs

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/09/28_Corteva.asp
